evidence: Figure 1 : Overall architecture of MXI-MemICL. Stage embeddings from observations and instructions combine with predicted intent for retrieval. A visual–action causal encoder encodes completed interactions and optional demonstrations into memory. Retrieved experience and recent context form n n experience tokens that condition the shared backbone via prefixes and gated cross-attention, whose learned gates regulate injection strength. Backbone outputs support action generation and next-step intent prediction. The intention decoder and intention predictor use residual MLPs. Detailed diagrams of all modules are provided in the supplementary material.
